plugins.name: video-kit
plugins.description: Make launch videos, feature teasers, social clips and what's-new videos for your product, from its code or just its website, scene by scene or cinematic with 3D, silent or narrated: /video-kit:make, /video-kit:website, /video-kit:voiceover and /video-kit:changelog. Built for anyone, no video skills needed.

plugins.name: pr-podcast
plugins.description: Turn a pull request, today's commits, a release or a date range into a 3–5 minute two-voice audio episode: what changed, why, and what's risky. Listen before opening the diff, play it at standup, or catch up after time off. Recorded on your computer with free, open voices: /pr-podcast:make, /pr-podcast:standup, /pr-podcast:release and /pr-podcast:catchup.
